_note: Shared by Genesis (RuleMessageCasesTests) and the blocks-data client. Change a message here and in the code together; the client copy must follow.

messages.AuthNotAllowed: Auth values aren't available in validation rules: use an access policy
messages.CommaInSingleValue: A single value can't contain a comma: use "is one of" for a list
messages.ConditionGroupEmpty: Each group of conditions needs at least one condition
messages.ConditionInsideList: A rule on a property inside a list of objects can't have a condition yet
messages.ConditionLeftMustBeProperty: A condition must start with a property of the record
messages.ConditionNeedsValue: Enter a value to compare with
messages.ConditionOnLookup: "Exists in" and "must not exist in" rules can't have a condition yet: use a filter on the other schema
messages.CountMustBeWholeNumber: Enter a whole number of items, 0 or more
messages.FieldComparisonItemId: ItemId can't be compared with another property
messages.FieldComparisonOperator: Two properties can only be compared with equals, is not, greater than or less than
messages.FilterMustUseFixedValues: A filter compares the other schema's properties with fixed values only
messages.FilterOnlyForReferences: Only "exists in" and "must not exist in" rules take a filter
messages.NotExistsInOwnSchema: A property can't be checked against its own schema: mark it as unique instead
messages.NotOnSystemSchemas: This rule can't be used on a system schema: system schemas take only the older rule types, with no condition, filter or date relative to now
messages.NowOnlyForComparisons: A date relative to now only works in greater than, less than and range rules
messages.NowOnlyForDates: A date relative to now only works on a date-time property
messages.OnlyForLists: This rule checks a list, so it only works on a list property
messages.PlaceholderNotAllowed: A fixed value can't contain {{…}}: compare with a property instead
messages.TargetSchemaRequired: Choose the schema to check against
messages.TooManyValues: Is one of / is not one of takes at most 500 values
messages.UniqueItemsNeedsValues: No duplicates works on a list of values, not a list of objects
messages.ValuesMustBeAList: Is one of / is not one of needs a list of values
messages.ValuesMustNotBeEmpty: Is one of / is not one of needs at least one value

formatted.text: "{{Now+x}}" isn't a date relative to now: write {{Now}}, {{Now-18y}} or {{Now+30d}} (units y, mo, d, h, min)
